|lore=Pilots are often reassigned at the last minute for a variety of tactical reasons. Darth Vader ordered DS-61-2 and DS-61-3 to accompany him to the Battle of Yavin.
|game_text=Use 1 Force to target a starfighter’s permanent pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on starfighter to remove permanent pilot (otherwise, Effect is lost). May add 1 pilot.
